3	How the **manager** orchestrates the Preparation Loop. The `leader` and `assistant` specialists that participate load [`preparation/SKILL.md`](../../preparation/SKILL.md) (leader's role spans both DISCUSSION and WORK) and [`memorization/SKILL.md`](../../memorization/SKILL.md) (assistant's MEMORIZATION procedure).
4	
5	The Preparation Loop runs **between Ideation and Planning**. Its job is to verify that the **project memory** and the **workspace skills** are ready for the planning and execution that follow. If something is missing that downstream work would need, Preparation surfaces it and the user decides how to resolve.
6	
7	| Phase | Content semantics for Preparation |
8	|---|---|
9	| `DISCUSSION` | Manager + user + leader (research-backed scan) identify readiness gaps and decide resolution per gap. |
10	| `WORK` | Leader documents the readiness assessment AND stages approved gap fixes (new skills, missed memory promotions) at `sessions/{date}-{session-id}/preparation/staging/`; Wrap-up promotes to project memory. |
11	| `EVALUATION` | Dual-system evaluators apply the leader's plan-evaluation criteria + perspective lenses. |
12	| `MEMORIZATION` | Assistant synthesizes canonical `preparation.md` into session staging only — project-memory promotion is the sole responsibility of Wrap-up. |
13	
14	---
15	
16	## DISCUSSION Phase (manager + user + leader)
17	
18	**Manager's job**: orchestrate the readiness review with the user, spawning the `leader` to scan project memory + workspace skills, then present found gaps for user resolution. Detailed sub-step content lives in [`preparation/SKILL.md`](../../preparation/SKILL.md); this section covers the **orchestration choreography**.
19	
20	### Leader spawn pattern
21	
22	Same pattern as Ideation and Planning. The leader is spawned for scans and proposals; the manager-user dialogue happens between leader returns:
23	
24	```
25	manager → opens DISCUSSION with user (state: "advancing from Ideation to Preparation")
26	manager → spawns leader: "read ideation/artifacts/ and produce a readiness signal list"
27	leader → reads ideation + memory + skills → returns scan results
28	manager → presents leader's gap analysis → AskUserQuestion per gap → user picks resolutions
29	manager → re-engages leader to apply approved fixes during WORK
30	```
31	
32	### Sub-step orchestration
33	
34	The manager runs the user through five sub-steps in order. Each is gated by AskUserQuestion before advancing.
35	
36	| # | Sub-step | Manager's role | Leader's contribution |
37	|---|---|---|---|
38	| A | Read Ideation Output | Confirm Ideation output is complete; user signals readiness to advance | Read `ideation/artifacts/` + accumulated feature memory; output a readiness signal list (files / domains / perspectives the downstream work will need) |
39	| B | Design + Memory Readiness Check | Present found gaps; user decides per gap | Scan `features/{feature-name}/design/`, `scenarios/`, `checklists/`, `decisions/`, `mistakes/` against the readiness signal list; propose resolution per missing item |
40	| C | Execution Skills Readiness Check | Approve skill generation per gap via AskUserQuestion | Identify missing project-specific skills (e.g., `{project}-typescript-conventions`); propose generate / defer / re-Ideate |
41	| D | Gap Resolution Plan | Run AskUserQuestion per gap to lock the resolution table | Present the consolidated gap table (category / severity / proposal); record user decisions |
42	
43	### When to escalate to user
44	
45	The leader brings draft proposals; the user makes final calls. Every decision below requires AskUserQuestion:
46	
47	- Confirmation that Ideation output is sound enough to proceed (Sub-step A)
48	- Per-gap resolution: generate now / defer / re-Ideate / skip (Sub-steps B / C / D)
49	- Skill slug for any newly-generated project-specific skill (Sub-step D)
50	
51	### Re-Ideate routing
52	
53	If any gap's resolution is **Re-Ideate**, Preparation halts:
54	1. Manager records the re-Ideate decision and the gap that triggered it in the discussion log.
55	2. Manager re-enters the Ideation Loop with the gap as new input.
56	3. After Ideation re-completes, Preparation re-runs from Sub-step A.
57	
58	This is **not** a Preparation `REVISE` — it's an upstream loop re-entry. Preparation's own iteration counter does not increment.
59	
60	---
61	
62	## WORK Phase (leader documents + executes approved gap fixes)
63	
64	**Manager's job**: spawn the leader for documentation. The leader writes the draft at `sessions/{date}-{session-id}/preparation/rawdata/draft-iter{n}.md` AND stages the approved gap fixes at `sessions/{date}-{session-id}/preparation/staging/`. Wrap-up is the sole promoter of staged artifacts to project memory — with one narrow exception: generated skills are promoted before Planning starts (see below).
65	
66	Manager-side responsibilities:
67	- Confirm the draft contains every required section (Scope reference / Readiness summary / per-category readiness / Generated this loop / Deferred / Decisions log)
68	- Verify that every "Generate now" decision produced a real artifact on disk (the leader is expected to do this; the manager spot-checks)
69	- Stage the draft and prior leader transcripts in `rawdata/`
70	- On re-entry from a `REVISE` ITER, pass prior evaluator findings as additional input
71	
72	WORK execution is more than documentation here, because Preparation's purpose is to **make the gaps go away**. New skills are staged at `sessions/{date}-{session-id}/preparation/staging/skills/{slug}/SKILL.md` — the staging step closes the gap for downstream planning. On EVALUATION PASS, the manager copies `preparation/staging/skills/{slug}/SKILL.md` → `.gobbi/projects/{project-name}/skills/{slug}/SKILL.md` BEFORE Planning starts (per `preparation/SKILL.md` narrow sole-writer exception — in-session consumers need the skill available during Planning and Execution). All other Preparation staging follows the standard Wrap-up promotion path.
73	
74	---
75	
76	## EVALUATION Phase (delegated to evaluators)
77	
78	**Manager's job**: orchestrate the dual-system evaluator spawn per [`workflow/evaluation.md`](evaluation.md). Preparation-specific notes:
79	
80	- **Perspectives**: all seven + Overall (no pruning per evaluation contract)
81	- **Output path**: per-iter scoped at `sessions/{date}-{session-id}/preparation/evaluation/iter{n}/{system}/{perspective}.md`
82	- Phase-specific focus typically emphasizes gap coverage (was every needed item checked?), generation quality (do new skills meet the project's template bar?), and re-Ideate triggering (is any gap actually unworkable rather than just missing?)
83	- The evaluators verify the leader's generated artifacts pass the same quality bar that the `interview` skill enforces for stamped skills
84	
85	---
86	
87	## MEMORIZATION Phase (delegated to `assistant`)
88	
89	**Manager's job**: spawn the `assistant` agent. The assistant synthesizes canonical `preparation.md` per [`workflow/memorization.md`](memorization.md) and [`memorization/SKILL.md`](../../memorization/SKILL.md). For Preparation, the assistant also stages Wrap-up routing candidates:
90	
91	- New project-specific skills from this loop → `sessions/{date}-{session-id}/preparation/staging/skills/{slug}/SKILL.md`
92	- `scenario_gap` / `checklist_gap` findings → `sessions/{date}-{session-id}/preparation/staging/{scenarios,checklists}/{slug}.md`
93	
94	Wrap-up reads these staging directories and routes them to `features/{feature-name}/README.md`, `features/{feature-name}/scenarios/`, and `features/{feature-name}/checklists/` per its promotion routing table.
95	
96	---
97	
98	## ITER / EXIT Decision
99	
100	After `MEMORIZATION`, the manager decides based on the reconciled verdict:
101	
102	| Verdict | Action |
103	|---|---|
104	| `PASS` | Exit the loop; advance to Planning Loop |
105	| `REVISE` | Re-enter `DISCUSSION` with evaluator findings as new input |
106	| `FAIL` | Escalate via AskUserQuestion; user decides revise / re-enter Ideation / abort |
107	| `RE-IDEATE` | Special verdict — at least one gap is unworkable without re-Ideation. Manager re-enters the Ideation Loop, then re-runs Preparation. |
108	| `SKIPPED` | Exit the loop (Preparation was skipped per settings — only valid when project memory is mature and the manager is confident no gaps exist) |
109	
110	Iteration cap: `workflow.preparation.maxIterations` (default 3). When the cap is reached without `PASS`, the manager forces user escalation.
111	
112	---
113	
114	## Output
115	
116	```
117	.gobbi/projects/{project}/sessions/{date}-{session-id}/preparation/
118	├── preparation.md          ← canonical synthesized output (assistant, MEMORIZATION)
119	├── rawdata/                ← leader drafts (per iteration), agent transcripts (scan + WORK), discussion log
120	└── evaluation/
121	    ├── claude/{perspective}.md
122	    └── codex/{perspective}.md
123	```

125	Plus session-staged outputs by the leader during WORK — routed to project memory by Wrap-up only:
126	- New project-specific skills → `sessions/{date}-{session-id}/preparation/staging/skills/{slug}/SKILL.md`
127	- Missed memory promotion candidates → `sessions/{date}-{session-id}/preparation/staging/{type}/{slug}.md` (Wrap-up promotes these to project memory at session close)
128
